description: Removes a contact (or cancels a request you sent) on both sides. Shared groups are not affected.

handle.description: Exact handle of one of your contacts (no @ needed). If your human gives a name, call list_contacts and match display_name; never guess.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string you make up for this action, 8-128 characters (a UUID works). Reuse the same key only to retry this exact call.

name: remove_contact
title: Remove a contact
